findings.note: ESPN (Nov 18) says the Colts will be without both starting tackles, Raimann and Travis, which is a concern after Will Anderson Jr.'s impact in the first meeting; Houston is also without Hunter, Marks, Harrison Jr. and Al-Shaair.

CBS lists the game at Texans -12.5 and says the Colts ruled out five players while CB Sauce Gardner is questionable after not practicing all week; Houston's questionable players Teller and Smith practiced fully.
NFL.com shows the Colts at 3-7 and the Texans at 3-6, a small record gap for a 12.5-point spread, with key players out on both sides.
SportsLine's simulation model picks Over 44.5 and projects 51 total points; the page also says Texans WR Marvin Harrison Jr. and RB Woody Marks are out, while RB David Montgomery is set to return.
Covers' AI projects Texans 27-20, a 47-point total, and leans Over 44.5, but warns that Colts protection problems that stall drives would undercut the Over even if Houston controls the game.

Covers says Texans LB Azeez Al-Shaair, the leading tackler, went on IR; weather is a non-factor under the retractable roof; Kalshi prices shade slightly toward the Under at 44.5; and the analyst's pick is Colts +10.5, not the total.
